import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { useDebounce } from '../hooks/useDebounce'
import { useLocalStorage } from '../hooks/useLocalStorage'
import { get } from '../lib/api'
import { truncate } from '../lib/utils'
import type { Testimonial } from '../types'

interface TestimonialsProps {
  id?: string
  title?: string
  subtitle?: string
  autoPlay?: boolean
  interval?: number
}

const defaultTestimonials: Testimonial[] = [
  {
    id: 't1',
    name: 'Sarah Chen',
    role: 'CTO, TechFlow',
    quote: 'This stack transformed our development workflow. The developer experience is unmatched and our team velocity has doubled.',
    avatar: 'https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=Sarah+Chen&background=6366f1&color=fff',
    rating: 5,
    date: '2026-01-15',
  },
  {
    id: 't2',
    name: 'Marcus Johnson',
    role: 'Lead Engineer, DataPulse',
    quote: 'TypeScript + React Query gave us type-safe data fetching with caching built in. No more race conditions or stale data.',
    avatar: 'https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=Marcus+Johnson&background=0ea5e9&color=fff',
    rating: 5,
    date: '2026-02-03',
  },
  {
    id: 't3',
    name: 'Priya Patel',
    role: 'Product Designer, Nova',
    quote: 'The component architecture is clean and reusable. Tailwind made our design system consistent across every page.',
    avatar: 'https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=Priya+Patel&background=f59e0b&color=fff',
    rating: 4,
    date: '2026-02-20',
  },
  {
    id: 't4',
    name: 'Alex Rivera',
    role: 'Full-Stack Dev, CloudSync',
    quote: 'Zustand for client state, React Query for server state. The separation of concerns is exactly what a modern app needs.',
    avatar: 'https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=Alex+Rivera&background=10b981&color=fff',
    rating: 5,
    date: '2026-03-01',
  },
]

export default function Testimonials({
  id = 'testimonials',
  title = 'What Our Users Say',
  subtitle = 'Trusted by teams building the future of software',
  autoPlay = true,
  interval = 5000,
}: TestimonialsProps) {
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0)
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false)
  const [testimonials, setTestimonials] = useLocalStorage<Testimonial[]>(
    'testimonials',
    defaultTestimonials,
  )
  const timerRef = useRef<number | null>(null)
  const carouselRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)

  const debouncedIndex = useDebounce(activeIndex, 100)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!autoPlay || isPaused || testimonials.length === 0) return

    timerRef.current = window.setInterval(() => {
      setActiveIndex((prev) => (prev + 1) % testimonials.length)
    }, interval)

    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) window.clearInterval(timerRef.current)
    }
  }, [autoPlay, isPaused, interval, testimonials.length])

  useEffect(() => {
    // Fetch fresh testimonials from API (non-blocking)
    let cancelled = false
    get<Testimonial[]>('/testimonials')
      .then((res) => {
        if (!cancelled && res.data.length > 0) {
          setTestimonials(res.data)
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {
        // Silently fall back to defaults
      })
    return () => {
      cancelled = true
    }
  }, [])

  const handleDotClick = (index: number) => {
    setActiveIndex(index)
    setIsPaused(true)
  }

  const handleArrow = (direction: 'prev' | 'next') => {
    setIsPaused(true)
    setActiveIndex((prev) => {
      const len = testimonials.length
      if (direction === 'next') return (prev + 1) % len
      return (prev - 1 + len) % len
    })
  }


  if (testimonials.length === 0) {
    return null
  }

  return (
    <section id={id} className="py-20 md:py-28 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl text-center mb-12">
          <h2 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
            {title}
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-3 text-lg text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
            {subtitle}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div
          ref={carouselRef}
          className="relative"
          onMouseEnter={() => setIsPaused(true)}
          onMouseLeave={() => setIsPaused(false)}
        >
          {/* Carousel content */}
          <div className="relative min-h-[280px] md:min-h-[320px]">
            {testimonials.map((t, i) => (
              <div
                key={t.id}
                className={`absolute inset-0 transition-all duration-700 ease-in-out ${
                  i === debouncedIndex
                    ? 'opacity-100 scale-100'
                    : 'opacity-0 scale-105 pointer-events-none'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="mx-auto max-w-2xl text-center">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1 mb-4">
                    {Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, star) => (
                      <span
                        key={star}
                        className={`text-2xl transition-colors ${
                          star < t.rating
                            ? 'text-amber-400'
                            : 'text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-700'
                        }`}
                      >
                        ★
                      </span>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  <blockquote className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 leading-relaxed mb-6">
                    &ldquo;{truncate(t.quote, 200)}&rdquo;
                  </blockquote>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3">
                    <img
                      src={t.avatar}
                      alt={t.name}
                      className="h-14 w-14 rounded-full object-cover ring-2 ring-slate-200 dark:ring-slate-700"
                      loading="lazy"
                    />
                    <div className="text-left">
                      <p className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                        {t.name}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                        {t.role}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Navigation arrows */}
          <button
            onClick={() => handleArrow('prev')}
            aria-label="Previous testimonial"
            className="absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 left-4 md:left-8 z-10 h-10 w-10 rounded-full bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-800/80 backdrop-blur-sm border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-white dark:hover:bg-slate-700 transition-colors"
          >
            <svg
              className="w-5 h-5"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth="2"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
            >
              <path d="M15 19l-7-7 7-7" />
            </svg>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => handleArrow('next')}
            aria-label="Next testimonial"
            className="absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 right-4 md:right-8 z-10 h-10 w-10 rounded-full bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-800/80 backdrop-blur-sm border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-white dark:hover:bg-slate-700 transition-colors"
          >
            <svg
              className="w-5 h-5"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth="2"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
            >
              <path d="M9 5l7 7-7 7" />
            </svg>
          </button>

          {/* Dot indicators */}
          <div className="flex justify-center gap-2 mt-8">
            {testimonials.map((t, i) => (
              <button
                key={t.id}
                onClick={() => handleDotClick(i)}
                aria-label={`Go to testimonial ${i + 1}`}
                className={`h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${
                  i === debouncedIndex
                    ? 'bg-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-400 scale-125'
                    : 'bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-400 dark:hover:bg-slate-500'
                }`}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}
